note: Not legal advice. 'verified' = read on the platform or regulator's own page; 'secondary' = reported by agencies or press, re-check before relying on it. Re-fetch the sources when last_checked is more than 30 days old.

rules.rule: AI content must not show a core product effect the product cannot deliver.
rules.check: Every on-screen result (cleaning, glowing, fitting, lifting, curing) is something the real product does, with proof the seller holds.

rules.rule: No AI before/after that compresses time or implies instant results without evidence.
rules.check: Before/after shots show a realistic time span and the seller has evidence.

rules.rule: AI must not change quantity or bundle, enlarge or thicken the product, add accessories, show a wrong install position, animate a static product or imply compatibility it lacks.
rules.check: Compare every product shot with the listing: count, size, accessories, installation, compatibility.

rules.rule: Significant AI content must be disclosed; real people must not be impersonated.
rules.check: AI label on; no real person's face or voice without consent.

rules.rule: LIVE: no AI voices, pre-recorded narration or radio; speech must be real-time. Stills or loops at most 50% of the screen.
rules.check: Applies to LIVE only.

rules.rule: Shoppable videos need at least 3 s of moving footage and no screenshots of the product page; AI voiceover in recorded shoppable videos is reported as high risk.
rules.check: Moving footage ≥3 s; no product-page screenshots; prefer a human or clearly labelled voice.

rules.rule: 5+ non-interactive or misleading Shop videos in 7 days triggers a posting limit.
rules.check: Batch volume per account per week.

rules.rule: Turn on 'This ad contains AI-generated content' for fully AI media or real media significantly changed by AI.
rules.check: Toggle set in Ads Manager.

rules.rule: Realistic AI-generated content must carry the AI label; TikTok also auto-labels from C2PA Content Credentials.
rules.check: AI label on; C2PA metadata left in the file.

rules.rule: Ads made or significantly edited with AI, and photorealistic AI people, get the 'AI info' label; third-party AI is detected from C2PA/IPTC signals.
rules.check: Expect the label; do not strip metadata; disclose realistic AI people.

rules.rule: No before/after weight-loss images, no person on a scale for diet products, no negative self-image.
rules.check: Health, diet and beauty visuals.

rules.rule: No copy that asserts or implies personal attributes ('Are you diabetic?', 'Tired of your belly fat?').
rules.check: 'You' statements about health, body, finances, identity.

rules.rule: Tick 'altered or synthetic' for realistic content (a real person's likeness, altered real events, realistic generated scenes); clearly unrealistic or animated content is exempt.
rules.check: Disclosure box in Studio for realistic AI scenes.

rules.rule: No fake reviews or testimonials, including AI-generated ones and ones from people who don't exist or never used the product (16 CFR 465). Civil penalties ~$51-53k per violation.
rules.check: An AI person saying 'I tried it', 'my results', 'I've been using this' = block.

rules.rule: Endorsement Guides (16 CFR 255): virtual influencers are endorsers; material connections must be disclosed clearly and conspicuously, in the video itself on TikTok.
rules.check: #ad / paid partnership in-video for affiliates and sponsored posts.

rules.rule: Health claims need competent and reliable scientific evidence (generally RCTs); 'may' or 'helps' doesn't cure an unsupported claim.
rules.check: Every health or efficacy claim matched to evidence.

rules.rule: Earnings and profit claims must be truthful and typical; 'make money' content without substantiation is deceptive.
rules.check: Profit, income, 'without touching the product' claims: typical results, real numbers, no guarantees.

rules.rule: Ads reaching New York must conspicuously disclose synthetic performers (GBL § 396-b); $1,000 first, $5,000 later violations.
rules.check: AI person on screen + NY audience = visible disclosure.

rules.rule: Deepfakes must be labelled by deployers from 2026-08-02; machine-readable marking duties for providers follow (Digital Omnibus).
rules.check: Realistic AI people or scenes in EU ads: visible AI label; keep provenance metadata.

rules.rule: AI footage framed as real events (security cam 'caught on camera', fake news clips, fake customers) is deceptive unless labelled as AI.
rules.check: CCTV, dashcam or 'real customer' framing + AI label.

rules.rule: Some landmarks and brands need approval for ad use (e.g. Burj Khalifa per Emaar's asset policy); never put other brands' logos or characters in an ad.
rules.check: Landmarks in focus, logos, famous characters or 'in the style of' a studio.
